result.title: ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression
result.summary: Some observation-window-based KV cache compressors use prompt attention to identify important tokens but allocate uniform or predefined budgets across heads, overlooking input-dependent differences in budget demand. We propose ChampionKV, an input-adaptive head-wise budget allocator for long-context KV cache compression. It uses the maximum aggregated observation-window attention score as a lightweight empirical proxy for attention concentration, assigning larger budgets to heads with dispersed attention and smaller budgets to concentrated heads. An abnormal-head mask and a floor-budget mechanism improve robustness under weak attention responses. ChampionKV plugs into compressors such as SnapKV and PyramidKV without changing their token-selection procedures. On LongBench and RULER, both Champion variants consistently improve over their SnapKV and PyramidKV base compressors; the improvements are largest and statistically significant on Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, especially under tight budgets, whereas results on the tested 7B/8B models remain competitive but mixed. ChampionKV does not uniformly outperform Ada-KV, whose global cross-head Top-K selection retains an advantage in several settings. Controlled analysis further shows improved retained attention mass over the corresponding base compressors at negligible overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ChampionKV：面向长上下文 KV cache 压缩的输入自适应 head 级预算分配器，用 observation-window 注意力聚合峰值作为注意力集中度的经验代理，偏向分散的 head 多分预算，并加入异常 head 掩码与预算下限；可挂载 SnapKV、PyramidKV，在 LongBench 与 RULER 上评测。
